digest.component_or_area: observability and monitoring for autodeploy review interrupts
propositions: review_interrupts metric is published without reason dimension, preventing CloudWatch-only sweeps from distinguishing bound-exceeded (bot busy, drain check working) from signal-unavailable (health probe broken, deploys blind)

distinct metrics review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable must be emitted separately alongside the unchanged rolled-up review_interrupts by splitting journal patterns in observability.sh
two separate dimensionless CloudWatch alarms (one per reason) must replace the single review_interrupts alarm in monitoring_autodeploy.tf, each with its own remediation description
signal-unavailable alarm must remain promptly firing (evaluation_periods=1, datapoints_to_alarm=1) to catch immediate probe failure
terraform apply of the new alarm configuration is required to take effect and complete acceptance criteria
